map_info.name: Museum_AAA_Uffizi_Cohort_10
map_info.title: Uffizi Footprint Cohort: Ten Contracts
map_info.description: Ten canonical Uffizi side-bay offers are drawn first; ten artifact contracts then negotiate onto them without weakening the public spine.

learning_objectives: Read the Uffizi route before reading its contents
Compare ten explicit placement contracts against identical bay offers
Distinguish invariant circulation from negotiated exhibition space

invariants: 1 m display and podium band outside the clear route
one aligned two-cell spine doorway per bay
axial end-stop visible down the entrance spine
negotiable: side-room width may grow only away from the spine
individual bay depth may grow along the spine
vertical envelope follows the artifact contract
support tile may rise to one metre for table, plinth, pedestal, or platform contracts
forbidden: blocking an aligned spine doorway or enfilade threshold
placing an artifact anchor or preferred footprint in the spine
placing two artifact footprints in the same bay

placement_overlay.placement_intent: An intimate island pedestal with a complete walking orbit; the beam makes the chosen zero legible at body scale.
negotiation: accepted by canonical 8 x 7 m bay

placement_overlay.placement_intent: A solitary control that may stand freely but prefers the north wall: a 2 cm installation gap, no rear circulation, two metres of frontal interaction space, and no neighboring artifacts or separate display props.
negotiation: accepted by canonical 8 x 7 m bay

placement_overlay.placement_intent: The bare Phi control rail is not a floor artifact. The museum must mount it on a one-metre working surface, preserve a three-metre frontal bay, and keep neighboring artifacts outside that bay.
negotiation: accepted by canonical 8 x 7 m bay

placement_overlay.placement_intent: A low island stage with a complete perimeter route; the museum owns the room, so the artifact's legacy 10 m floor is disabled.
negotiation: bay widened 3 m away from spine

placement_overlay.placement_intent: A narrow embodied-randomness kiosk with a clear standing bay and protected space for the visitor's leash gesture.
negotiation: accepted by canonical 8 x 7 m bay

placement_overlay.placement_intent: A thin entropy instrument mounted at reading height on the wall, freeing the floor for a three-metre interpretation bay.
negotiation: accepted by canonical 8 x 7 m bay

placement_overlay.placement_intent: A circular harmonic instrument hosted on a working table, with a shared listening and performance position on every side.
negotiation: accepted by canonical 8 x 7 m bay

placement_overlay.placement_intent: A floor-standing loom with an asymmetric eight-metre bay: compact service space behind and a protected runway for generated textile in front.
A room-scale optimization landscape whose full measured surface and height govern the gallery, with a continuous orbit for comparing descent paths.
negotiation: bay widened 5 m away from spine

placement_overlay.placement_intent: A tall network section whose active ten-metre body defines a dedicated hall with two clear reading fronts and one integrated live-telemetry plate.
negotiation: bay widened 6 m away from spine
